See [instructions](https://docs.cloud.google.com/agent-registry/search-agents-and-tools) for more details. Allowed operators: `=`, `:`, `NOT`, `AND`, `OR`, and `()`. Searchable fields: | Field | `=` | `:` | `*` | Keyword Search | |--------------------|-----|-----|-----|----------------| | mcpServerId | Yes | Yes | Yes | Included | | name | No | Yes | Yes | Included | | displayName | No | Yes | Yes | Included | Examples: * `mcpServerId="urn:mcp:projects-123:projects:123:locations:us-central1:agentregistry:services:service-id"` to find the MCP Server with the specified MCP Server ID. * `name:important` to find MCP Servers whose name contains `important` as a word. * `displayName:works*` to find MCP Servers whose display name contains words that start with `works`. * `planner OR booking` to find MCP Servers whose metadata contains the words `planner` or `booking`. * `mcpServerId:service-id AND (displayName:planner OR displayName:booking)` to find MCP Servers whose MCP Server ID contains `service-id` and whose display name contains `planner` or `booking`.
